# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

The gap that remained actionable: **the grammar-side regression pin lived inside the quarantined file, and the quarantine skip is per-FILE** (`scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the whole path) — no PR gate has executed the canonicalizer pin since #1423 quarantined it.

  - the settlement notice block (4 `│ ⚙` rows + wrap continuation) stays transcript grammar;
  - the red scenario's settled cards canonicalize identically across legs (live `0s` vs replay `—`, the #916 contract);
  - the red live screen normalizes to the post-#1420 tail, the red resumed tail is canonicalizer-idempotent, and the two tails **align 1:1 on the last-liveTail-length window — the exact assertion that red at those SHAs** (it fails under pre-`4b81205c` classification, passes at HEAD).

## Delivered vs remaining

- [x] Both red signatures root-caused to product bugs already fixed on main (#1410 / #1420), with FILE:LINE and commit evidence
- [x] Regression guard for the AC1 canonicalizer restored to **gate visibility** (new un-quarantined pin file, PTY-free)
- [x] Sig-1 guard verified already gate-visible (`test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart` — not quarantined)
- [x] No quarantine-list churn (contested file untouched), no PTY-flow changes, no product-code churn
- [ ] **Un-quarantine** `test/integration/pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart` (remove the entry at `scripts/test_quarantine.json:141-150`) — blocked on the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof showing **both** prior red paths green (nightly keeps running the file supervised). Bot/SM-owned; this PR is the fix-PR reference the entry's review needs.
- [ ] Optional follow-up after un-quarantine: screen-anchored wait (`waitForScreen`) on the last replayed notice row ahead of the settle snapshot — deferred because the quarantined file cannot be exercised per-PR, making any flow change unverifiable until nightly.

## Local execution evidence

`dart` on this host is sandbox-blocked: homebrew shim fails on the flutter engine stamp, and the direct VM binary is `Killed: 9` (exit 137) — `dart --version` itself cannot run, so no local test/analyze/format execution was possible (consistent with the openpty-denied evidence from sibling lanes; this host cannot run PTY suites at all). The fix is driven entirely from the red-run job logs (jobs API, FILE:LINE above) plus code reading; no local green is claimed or fabricated. The pin file is deliberately PTY-free so the gate CAN execute it.

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
Now check the integration shard step at ci.yml line 788-810 to see how the manifest is executed — per-file or directory.

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1493
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1493
- **Title**: fix(1422): gate-visible red-data pin for the AC1 resume-1:1 transcript canonicalizer
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1422-resume-render-equivalence` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +233
- **Deletions**: -0
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1422

## Root cause — both signatures predate their fixes on main

All three red runs landed on PR-head SHAs **older than the two commits that structurally close them** (none is an ancestor of current `main`):

| Red run | SHA (2026-10-08) | Signature | Root cause | Fixed on main by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [37774628085](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37774628085) | `77a4efc6` 12:09Z | 30 s `Background shell job` banner wait timeout — every scripted bash call died `Tool error (bash): Cannot modify an unmodifiable list` | the #1408 red-head: `redactBashCommandSecretShapes` sorted `layerVendor`'s **const empty list** on a quick-screen miss, crashing every bash call repo-wide (fa_cube ×7, shellTool suite, shell_jobs, composer grid — the run-wide outbreak in the issue thread) | `98ba890b8` (#1410, 22:30Z) — emptiness check precedes the sort; `lib/src/approval/bash_shape_redaction.dart:107-112` documents it verbatim |
| [37798533323](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37798533323) | `d0c2224a` 15:13Z | resumed-tail equality off-by-one at `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart:313` | the live screen still showed the gh-1415 subagent board row `✓ done pty446 …` below the notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board rows (terminal-first-sight) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as transcript grammar | `336042cfd` (#1420, 20:25Z) — `_subagentBoardRow` classifies the board vocabulary as chrome |
| [37802938457](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37802938457) | `4b81205c` 15:43Z | same site, same shape (`313:9`, missing `✓ done pty446` row, window aligned one row early) | same | same |

The issue's fix-targeting (1) "root-cause the unmodifiable-list exception" is delivered by #1410 and guarded by `test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart:108` ("null for a command without any secret shape" — a no-shape command **is** the const-empty-list return, the exact crash path). (2) "wait on the spinner-settle row explicitly instead of a fixed 700 ms settle" is **obsolete under the #1420 design**: that row is chrome on both legs, and the resumed boot never paints it (terminal-first-sight), so waiting on it would hang the resumed leg; the 700 ms settle was never the red mechanism — both reds are structural.

## What this PR delivers

The gap that remained actionable: **the grammar-side regression pin lived inside the quarantined file, and the quarantine skip is per-FILE** (`scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the whole path) — no PR gate has executed the canonicalizer pin since #1423 quarantined it.

- **New `test/integration/pty_resume_transcript_pin_test.dart`** (233 lines, no PTY, `@Tags(['integration'])` → auto-bin-packed into the integration shards): replays the **verbatim failed-job dump rows** of both signature-2 runs through the production `transcriptOf`:
  - the exact red board row (`✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok`) and the full ⠿/⏸/✓/✗ × run/wait/done/fail vocabulary stay chrome;

+/// from the AC1 comparison entirely).

+  final out = resume_eq.transcriptOf([row, _anchor]);

+  return kept.isEmpty ? null : kept.single;
+}

+  '│ ⚙ Log: /tmp/fa446pVLZPVV/.fah/bash_jobs/sh-2-hn0vwtxwhq6jh520.log',

+  'bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',

+  '>_Fa done — the probes settled',
+  ..._noticeRows,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the gh-1199 AC6 flake quarantine to a set of test targets.

Reads candidate test paths (one per line) from stdin, or as positional
arguments, and prints the paths that STAY in the gate to stdout. Files
listed in scripts/test_quarantine.json are dropped — with a `::warning::`
per skip, so the gate log always shows what the quarantine is shielding
(E3: a quarantine must never swallow a real regression silently).

Usage (the CI legs pipe their shard selection through it):

    python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json 0 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    find test/integration -name '*_test.dart' \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check
        validates the quarantine list itself: entries must reference
        existing files that are tagged `integration` and carry an issue
        link — a stale or under-documented entry fails the static gate.

The list is checked in and reviewed in the fix PR; flake_watch.py
(auto-filed flake issues) proposes entries with the proving runs attached.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on a malformed list or --check failure.
"""

import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag

LIST_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         "test_quarantine.json")

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("file", "issue", "since", "runs")


def load_quarantine(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    entries = doc.get("quarantined")
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: 'quarantined' must be a list")
    return entries


def quarantined_files(entries: list) -> set:
    return {e["file"] for e in entries}


def check(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> int:
    """Validate the list; a stale/under-documented entry fails the gate."""
    ok = True
    try:
        entries = load_quarantine(path)
    except (OSError, json.JSONDecodeError, ValueError) as e:
        print(f"::error::{e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    for e in entries:
        name = e.get("file", "<missing file>")
        for field in REQUIRED_FIELDS:
            if not e.get(field):
                ok = False
                print(f"::error::quarantine entry {name}: missing '{field}' "
                      f"(every entry needs {list(REQUIRED_FIELDS)})",
                      file=sys.stderr)
        file = e.get("file")
        if file and not os.path.isfile(file):
            ok = False
            print(f"::error::quarantine entry {name}: file does not exist — "
                  f"remove the entry (fix landed) or fix the path",
                  file=sys.stderr)
        elif file and not file_has_tag(file, "integration"):
            ok = False
            print(f"::error::quarantine entry {name}: file is not tagged "

tags:
  integration:
    # Integration tests spawn real processes / network and are excluded from the
    # pre-commit gate. Run them manually with: dart test --tags integration
  browser-ext:
    # Headless-Chrome extension suite (test/browser_ext/). CI runs it only
    # through the dedicated browser-ext.yml workflow (builds sw/agent.js and
    # supplies Chrome for Testing); ci.yml's tag job excludes it:
    # dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext
  llm:
    # Real-provider smoke tests (issue #551): hit live provider APIs and need
    # secrets. They carry `integration` too and run ONLY in the tag-only
    # provider-smoke job (v* tags) and nightly — every per-PR suite excludes
    # them: dart test --exclude-tags llm
    #
    # gh-1199: the boundary is now enforced at the gate's integration shard
    # SELECTION too (shard_files.py --exclude-tag llm, asserted by
    # test/scripts/shard_files_llm_boundary_test.dart) and by
    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file
    # without this tag fails the static gate. See docs/live-llm-testing.md.
    #
    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),
    # so the pin lives on the CI invocations: the per-PR integration shards run
    # `--concurrency=4`, which bounds concurrent live-provider tests PER JOB at
    # 4 (they previously ran at the default = CPU count). gh-1005 (2026-09-30)
    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.
  pty:
    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task
    # tool spawn — a second CLI process whose boot/JIT time is unbounded on a
    # loaded runner. They carry `integration` too and run in the per-PR
    # sharded legs (the shard manifest includes them — bounded
    # --concurrency, prewarmed boots) and nightly; the no-key
    # integration-mock leg still excludes them: dart test --exclude-tags pty
  io:
    # IO tests use dart:io primitives (local sockets, processes) and are
    # excluded from the default pre-commit gate. Run them with:
    # dart test --tags io
  perf:
    # Perf gates (issue #262): generate large fixtures and assert open
    # budgets. Selected by --tags integration in CI; run standalone with
    # dart test --tags perf
  reg-parity:
    # omp REG parity suite (issue #810): structural diff of the committed
    # omp reference twins vs fa's pure-Dart engine renders. Fast, hermetic
    # (no PTY, no network), SKIPs when the fixtures are not captured yet.
    # Merge-blocking through the EXISTING legs: ci.yml test-core (dart test
    # runs it) and the pty-visual job (fa_omp_reg_visual_test.dart) both
    # aggregate into Quality gate; the pre-commit hook's test-core stage
    # runs the same suite, so hook/CI marker parity holds with no new
    # stage. Standalone: dart test test/cli/omp_reg_parity_test.dart

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
Now check the integration shard step at ci.yml line 788-810 to see how the manifest is executed — per-file or directory.

# error default), so this chmod only ever touches the verified
      # bundle the fa-aot-build job produced.
      - name: Restore exec bit (artifact zips drop permissions)
        run: chmod +x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
      - name: Smoke the AOT binary (fail loud, never JIT-fallback)
        run: |
          test -x fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
          ./fa-local/bundle/bin/fah --version
      - name: dart test --tags integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn (pty_harness + the
          # headless helpers via faCliCommand) runs the AOT binary —
          # ~1 s per spawn instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on
          # loaded ARM runners). Per-test isolation is unchanged.
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          # gh-1199 AC1: --exclude-tag llm keeps every live-provider file
          # out of the merge-blocking selection (manifest unit AND runtime
          # bin-pack); --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm is the dart-test
          # backstop. AC6: the quarantine filter drops flake-quarantined
          # files (scripts/test_quarantine.json) pending their fix PRs.
          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py)
          echo "shard targets: $targets"
          if [ -z "$targets" ]; then
            echo "shard fully quarantined — nothing to run"
            exit 0
          fi
          mkdir -p test-results
          dart test --tags integration --exclude-tags browser-ext,llm \
            --concurrency=4 \
            --coverage=coverage \
            --file-reporter="json:test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json" \
            $targets
      # The file-reporter writes the json even on a RED leg — convert +
      # upload must not be chained into the failing step (#928 review):
      # timing evidence is exactly what red runs need to keep.
      - name: junit durations (shard ${{ matrix.shard }})
        if: always()
        run: >-
          python3 scripts/junit_from_dart_json.py
          test-results/integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.json
          test-results/junit-integration-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}.xml
      # Raw dart json for the #928 duration gate (per-test spans incl. suite
      # paths); junit is the human/rebalancer-facing form of the same data.
      # Upload MUST stay on the current upload-artifact line (gh-995): the
      # gate's download-artifact v8 digest-validates every download, so an
      # old-line upload digest-mismatches and the shard merge loses its
      # report (test/release_hygiene_test.dart pins the pin).

      # gh-1412: each evidence upload carries a one-shot retry (the step

- **PR #**: 1493
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1493
- **Title**: fix(1422): gate-visible red-data pin for the AC1 resume-1:1 transcript canonicalizer
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1422-resume-render-equivalence` → `main`
- **State**: open

- **Additions**: +233
- **Deletions**: -0
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1422

## Root cause — both signatures predate their fixes on main

All three red runs landed on PR-head SHAs **older than the two commits that structurally close them** (none is an ancestor of current `main`):

| Red run | SHA (2026-10-08) | Signature | Root cause | Fixed on main by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [37774628085](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37774628085) | `77a4efc6` 12:09Z | 30 s `Background shell job` banner wait timeout — every scripted bash call died `Tool error (bash): Cannot modify an unmodifiable list` | the #1408 red-head: `redactBashCommandSecretShapes` sorted `layerVendor`'s **const empty list** on a quick-screen miss, crashing every bash call repo-wide (fa_cube ×7, shellTool suite, shell_jobs, composer grid — the run-wide outbreak in the issue thread) | `98ba890b8` (#1410, 22:30Z) — emptiness check precedes the sort; `lib/src/approval/bash_shape_redaction.dart:107-112` documents it verbatim |
| [37798533323](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37798533323) | `d0c2224a` 15:13Z | resumed-tail equality off-by-one at `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart:313` | the live screen still showed the gh-1415 subagent board row `✓ done pty446 …` below the notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board rows (terminal-first-sight) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as transcript grammar | `336042cfd` (#1420, 20:25Z) — `_subagentBoardRow` classifies the board vocabulary as chrome |
| [37802938457](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37802938457) | `4b81205c` 15:43Z | same site, same shape (`313:9`, missing `✓ done pty446` row, window aligned one row early) | same | same |

The issue's fix-targeting (1) "root-cause the unmodifiable-list exception" is delivered by #1410 and guarded by `test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart:108` ("null for a command without any secret shape" — a no-shape command **is** the const-empty-list return, the exact crash path). (2) "wait on the spinner-settle row explicitly instead of a fixed 700 ms settle" is **obsolete under the #1420 design**: that row is chrome on both legs, and the resumed boot never paints it (terminal-first-sight), so waiting on it would hang the resumed leg; the 700 ms settle was never the red mechanism — both reds are structural.

## What this PR delivers

The gap that remained actionable: **the grammar-side regression pin lived inside the quarantined file, and the quarantine skip is per-FILE** (`scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the whole path) — no PR gate has executed the canonicalizer pin since #1423 quarantined it.

- **New `test/integration/pty_resume_transcript_pin_test.dart`** (233 lines, no PTY, `@Tags(['integration'])` → auto-bin-packed into the integration shards): replays the **verbatim failed-job dump rows** of both signature-2 runs through the production `transcriptOf`:
  - the exact red board row (`✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok`) and the full ⠿/⏸/✓/✗ × run/wait/done/fail vocabulary stay chrome;
  - the settlement notice block (4 `│ ⚙` rows + wrap continuation) stays transcript grammar;
  - the red scenario's settled cards canonicalize identically across legs (live `0s` vs replay `—`, the #916 contract);
  - the red live screen normalizes to the post-#1420 tail, the red resumed tail is canonicalizer-idempotent, and the two tails **align 1:1 on the last-liveTail-length window — the exact assertion that red at those SHAs** (it fails under pre-`4b81205c` classification, passes at HEAD).

## Delivered vs remaining

- [x] Both red signatures root-caused to product bugs already fixed on main (#1410 / #1420), with FILE:LINE and commit evidence
- [x] Regression guard for the AC1 canonicalizer restored to **gate visibility** (new un-quarantined pin file, PTY-free)
- [x] Sig-1 guard verified already gate-visible (`test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart` — not quarantined)
- [x] No quarantine-list churn (contested file untouched), no PTY-flow changes, no product-code churn
- [ ] **Un-quarantine** `test/integration/pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart` (remove the entry at `scripts/test_quarantine.json:141-150`) — blocked on the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof showing **both** prior red paths green (nightly keeps running the file supervised). Bot/SM-owned; this PR is the fix-PR reference the entry's review needs.
- [ ] Optional follow-up after un-quarantine: screen-anchored wait (`waitForScreen`) on the last replayed notice row ahead of the settle snapshot — deferred because the quarantined file cannot be exercised per-PR, making any flow change unverifiable until nightly.

## Local execution evidence

`dart` on this host is sandbox-blocked: homebrew shim fails on the flutter engine stamp, and the direct VM binary is `Killed: 9` (exit 137) — `dart --version` itself cannot run, so no local test/analyze/format execution was possible (consistent with the openpty-denied evidence from sibling lanes; this host cannot run PTY suites at all). The fix is driven entirely from the red-run job logs (jobs API, FILE:LINE above) plus code reading; no local green is claimed or fabricated. The pin file is deliberately PTY-free so the gate CAN execute it.

+/// Gate-visible red-data regression pin for issue #1422 — the
+/// `AC1: resume renders 1:1 with live (normalized diff empty)` flake.
+///
+/// The flake red-died three times (runs 37798533323, 37774628085,
+/// 37802938457) at two sites inside `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart`'s
+/// AC1 PTY test:
+///
+/// - Signature 1 (run 37774628085): the live leg's 30 s `Background shell
+///   job` banner wait timed out because every scripted bash call died
+///   with `Tool error (bash): Cannot modify an unmodifiable list` — the
+///   #1408 red-head sorting `layerVendor`'s CONST empty list inside
+///   `redactBashCommandSecretShapes`. Fixed on main in 98ba890b8 (the
+///   emptiness check precedes the sort, lib/src/approval/
+///   bash_shape_redaction.dart) and pinned gate-side by
+///   test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart ("null for a command
+///   without any secret shape" — a no-shape command IS the
+///   const-empty-list return, the exact crash path).
+///
+/// - Signature 2 (runs 37798533323, 37802938457): the resumed tail
+///   aligned one row early. The live screen still showed the gh-1415
+///   subagent status board row `✓ done pty446 … 0s – …` below the
+///   settlement notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board
+///   rows (terminal-first-sight: rehydrated children are history, not
+///   news) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as
+///   transcript grammar, so the AC1 alignment window slid one row.
+///   Fixed on main in 336042cfd (#1420): the `_subagentBoardRow` rule
+///   classifies the board vocabulary as chrome. But the pin test
+///   carrying that rule lives inside the quarantined file, and the
+///   quarantine skip is PER-FILE (scripts/apply_quarantine.py drops the
+///   whole path from every PR gate) — so a canonicalizer regression
+///   would reach the AC1 PTY run before any gate caught it. This file
+///   re-pins the rule, and the red run's full row-level alignment,
+///   where every PR gate executes it. No PTY needed: everything below
+///   runs the production `transcriptOf` canonicalizer on the exact
+///   failed-job dump rows.
+///
+/// The fixtures are the failed-job dump rows verbatim (runs 37798533323
+/// and 37802938457, 2026-10-08), with the live-side settled cards rebuilt
+/// in the #916 band shapes the AC1 contract pins (`✔ name: detail 0s`
+/// live, `✔ name: detail —` replay). Un-quarantining the PTY file still
+/// requires the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof; this pin makes the
+/// grammar side of that proof continuously gate-checked in the meantime.
+@TestOn('vm')
+@Tags(['integration'])
+library;
+
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+import 'pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart' as resume_eq;
+
+/// The anchor row every single-row probe hides below: a grammar-looking
+/// (`>`-prefixed) row the trailing-trim walk stops at, so the row under
+/// test always reaches the chrome/canonical pass regardless of whether it
+/// is itself a trim breaker.
+const _anchor = '>_Fa anchor row';
+
+/// Runs one screen row through the production canonicalizer. Returns the
+/// canonical transcript form, or null when the row is chrome (dropped
+/// from the AC1 comparison entirely).
+String? _classify(String row) {
+  final out = resume_eq.transcriptOf([row, _anchor]);
+  final kept = out.where((r) => r != _anchor).toList();
+  return kept.isEmpty ? null : kept.single;
+}
+
+/// The settlement notice block as the red run's two screens painted it
+/// (identical on both legs — these rows replay 1:1 by contract).
+const _noticeRows = [
+  '│ ⚙ Background shell job sh-2-hn0vwtxwhq6jh520 finished with exit code 0.',
+  '│ ⚙ Command: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  '│ ⚙ Log: /tmp/fa446pVLZPVV/.fah/bash_jobs/sh-2-hn0vwtxwhq6jh520.log',
+  '│ ⚙ Check the result with bash_job (action: output) or by reading the log file,',
+  'and act on it when the result was awaited.',
+];
+
+/// The resumed screen's transcript at the red snapshot (run 37802938457
+/// failed-job dump, `resumed transcript` block) — already in canonical
+/// form, which the canonicalizer must reproduce verbatim (idempotence on
+/// its own output).
+const _redResumeTail = [
+  'run the pinned probes for four forty six',
+  '>_Fa ## Plan',
+  '• run pinned probes',
+  '1. first step',
+  '2. second step',
+  'bash: echo pinned-render-1',
+  'bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  'task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok',
+  '>_Fa done — the probes settled',
+  ..._noticeRows,
+];
+
+/// The live screen's transcript at the red snapshot (the same dump's
+/// `live transcript` block, 9 rows) — pre-#1420 this carried the board
+/// row the resumed boot never paints, which is the whole flake.
+const _redLiveTail = [
+  'bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  'task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok',
+  '>_Fa done — the probes settled',
+  ..._noticeRows,
+  '✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok',
+];
+
+void main() {
+  test(
+    'gh-1422 sig-2: the exact red board row is chrome, never transcript '
+    'grammar',
+    () {

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the gh-1199 AC6 flake quarantine to a set of test targets.

Reads candidate test paths (one per line) from stdin, or as positional
arguments, and prints the paths that STAY in the gate to stdout. Files
listed in scripts/test_quarantine.json are dropped — with a `::warning::`
per skip, so the gate log always shows what the quarantine is shielding
(E3: a quarantine must never swallow a real regression silently).

Usage (the CI legs pipe their shard selection through it):

    python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json 0 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    find test/integration -name '*_test.dart' \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check
        validates the quarantine list itself: entries must reference
        existing files that are tagged `integration` and carry an issue
        link — a stale or under-documented entry fails the static gate.

The list is checked in and reviewed in the fix PR; flake_watch.py
(auto-filed flake issues) proposes entries with the proving runs attached.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on a malformed list or --check failure.
"""

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag

LIST_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         "test_quarantine.json")

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("file", "issue", "since", "runs")


def load_quarantine(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    entries = doc.get("quarantined")
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: 'quarantined' must be a list")
    return entries


def quarantined_files(entries: list) -> set:
    return {e["file"] for e in entries}


def check(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> int:

    # scripts/check_llm_tag_boundary.py — a live-looking integration file

    # Rate limiting (issue #931 part 3.3): package:test forbids `concurrency`
    # in tag overrides (test_core _disallow('concurrency') for tag scopes, v1.32),

    # retired the mac leg: the per-PR suite runs ONCE (pty-integration-linux,
    # 3 shards x 4 = 12 concurrent live tests) and nightly's unsharded leg
    # runs hours later — the old mac+linux same-window doubling (24) is gone.
    # If provider 429s start flaking the leg, lower the knob; per-job rate
    # pinning across CI jobs has no native Actions primitive.

    # Child-agent-spawn PTY tests (issue #553): the test drives a full task

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

All three red runs landed on PR-head SHAs **older than the two commits that structurally close them** (none is an ancestor of current `main`):

| Red run | SHA (2026-10-08) | Signature | Root cause | Fixed on main by |
|---|---|---|---|---|

| [37798533323](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37798533323) | `d0c2224a` 15:13Z | resumed-tail equality off-by-one at `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart:313` | the live screen still showed the gh-1415 subagent board row `✓ done pty446 …` below the notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board rows (terminal-first-sight) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as transcript grammar | `336042cfd` (#1420, 20:25Z) — `_subagentBoardRow` classifies the board vocabulary as chrome |
| [37802938457](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37802938457) | `4b81205c` 15:43Z | same site, same shape (`313:9`, missing `✓ done pty446` row, window aligned one row early) | same | same |

The issue's fix-targeting (1) "root-cause the unmodifiable-list exception" is delivered by #1410 and guarded by `test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart:108` ("null for a command without any secret shape" — a no-shape command **is** the const-empty-list return, the exact crash path). (2) "wait on the spinner-settle row explicitly instead of a fixed 700 ms settle" is **obsolete under the #1420 design**: that row is chrome on both legs, and the resumed boot never paints it (terminal-first-sight), so waiting on it would hang the resumed leg; the 700 ms settle was never the red mechanism — both reds are structural.

The gap that remained actionable: **the grammar-side regression pin lived inside the quarantined file, and the quarantine skip is per-FILE** (`scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the whole path) — no PR gate has executed the canonicalizer pin since #1423 quarantined it.

- **New `test/integration/pty_resume_transcript_pin_test.dart`** (233 lines, no PTY, `@Tags(['integration'])` → auto-bin-packed into the integration shards): replays the **verbatim failed-job dump rows** of both signature-2 runs through the production `transcriptOf`:
  - the exact red board row (`✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok`) and the full ⠿/⏸/✓/✗ × run/wait/done/fail vocabulary stay chrome;
  - the settlement notice block (4 `│ ⚙` rows + wrap continuation) stays transcript grammar;
  - the red scenario's settled cards canonicalize identically across legs (live `0s` vs replay `—`, the #916 contract);
  - the red live screen normalizes to the post-#1420 tail, the red resumed tail is canonicalizer-idempotent, and the two tails **align 1:1 on the last-liveTail-length window — the exact assertion that red at those SHAs** (it fails under pre-`4b81205c` classification, passes at HEAD).

## Delivered vs remaining

- [x] Both red signatures root-caused to product bugs already fixed on main (#1410 / #1420), with FILE:LINE and commit evidence
- [x] Regression guard for the AC1 canonicalizer restored to **gate visibility** (new un-quarantined pin file, PTY-free)
- [x] Sig-1 guard verified already gate-visible (`test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart` — not quarantined)
- [x] No quarantine-list churn (contested file untouched), no PTY-flow changes, no product-code churn
- [ ] **Un-quarantine** `test/integration/pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart` (remove the entry at `scripts/test_quarantine.json:141-150`) — blocked on the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof showing **both** prior red paths green (nightly keeps running the file supervised). Bot/SM-owned; this PR is the fix-PR reference the entry's review needs.
- [ ] Optional follow-up after un-quarantine: screen-anchored wait (`waitForScreen`) on the last replayed notice row ahead of the settle snapshot — deferred because the quarantined file cannot be exercised per-PR, making any flow change unverifiable until nightly.

## Local execution evidence

`dart` on this host is sandbox-blocked: homebrew shim fails on the flutter engine stamp, and the direct VM binary is `Killed: 9` (exit 137) — `dart --version` itself cannot run, so no local test/analyze/format execution was possible (consistent with the openpty-denied evidence from sibling lanes; this host cannot run PTY suites at all). The fix is driven entirely from the red-run job logs (jobs API, FILE:LINE above) plus code reading; no local green is claimed or fabricated. The pin file is deliberately PTY-free so the gate CAN execute it.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the gh-1199 AC6 flake quarantine to a set of test targets.

Reads candidate test paths (one per line) from stdin, or as positional
arguments, and prints the paths that STAY in the gate to stdout. Files
listed in scripts/test_quarantine.json are dropped — with a `::warning::`
per skip, so the gate log always shows what the quarantine is shielding
(E3: a quarantine must never swallow a real regression silently).

Usage (the CI legs pipe their shard selection through it):

    python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json 0 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    find test/integration -name '*_test.dart' \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check
        validates the quarantine list itself: entries must reference
        existing files that are tagged `integration` and carry an issue
        link — a stale or under-documented entry fails the static gate.

The list is checked in and reviewed in the fix PR; flake_watch.py
(auto-filed flake issues) proposes entries with the proving runs attached.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on a malformed list or --check failure.
"""

import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag

LIST_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         "test_quarantine.json")

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("file", "issue", "since", "runs")


def load_quarantine(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    entries = doc.get("quarantined")
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: 'quarantined' must be a list")
    return entries


def quarantined_files(entries: list) -> set:
    return {e["file"] for e in entries}


def check(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> int:
    """Validate the list; a stale/under-documented entry fails the gate."""

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`

# Pull Request Information

- **PR #**: 1493
- **URL**: https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/pull/1493
- **Title**: fix(1422): gate-visible red-data pin for the AC1 resume-1:1 transcript canonicalizer
- **Author**: vabhzw17eg2qu4m9-bit
- **Branch**: `fix/1422-resume-render-equivalence` → `main`
- **State**: open
- **Files Changed**: 1
- **Additions**: +233
- **Deletions**: -0
- **Created**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z
- **Updated**: 2026-10-10T12:37:43Z

## PR Description

Fixes #1422

## Root cause — both signatures predate their fixes on main

All three red runs landed on PR-head SHAs **older than the two commits that structurally close them** (none is an ancestor of current `main`):

| Red run | SHA (2026-10-08) | Signature | Root cause | Fixed on main by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [37774628085](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37774628085) | `77a4efc6` 12:09Z | 30 s `Background shell job` banner wait timeout — every scripted bash call died `Tool error (bash): Cannot modify an unmodifiable list` | the #1408 red-head: `redactBashCommandSecretShapes` sorted `layerVendor`'s **const empty list** on a quick-screen miss, crashing every bash call repo-wide (fa_cube ×7, shellTool suite, shell_jobs, composer grid — the run-wide outbreak in the issue thread) | `98ba890b8` (#1410, 22:30Z) — emptiness check precedes the sort; `lib/src/approval/bash_shape_redaction.dart:107-112` documents it verbatim |
| [37798533323](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37798533323) | `d0c2224a` 15:13Z | resumed-tail equality off-by-one at `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart:313` | the live screen still showed the gh-1415 subagent board row `✓ done pty446 …` below the notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board rows (terminal-first-sight) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as transcript grammar | `336042cfd` (#1420, 20:25Z) — `_subagentBoardRow` classifies the board vocabulary as chrome |
| [37802938457](https://github.com/IstiN/flutter_agent_harness/actions/runs/37802938457) | `4b81205c` 15:43Z | same site, same shape (`313:9`, missing `✓ done pty446` row, window aligned one row early) | same | same |

The issue's fix-targeting (1) "root-cause the unmodifiable-list exception" is delivered by #1410 and guarded by `test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart:108` ("null for a command without any secret shape" — a no-shape command **is** the const-empty-list return, the exact crash path). (2) "wait on the spinner-settle row explicitly instead of a fixed 700 ms settle" is **obsolete under the #1420 design**: that row is chrome on both legs, and the resumed boot never paints it (terminal-first-sight), so waiting on it would hang the resumed leg; the 700 ms settle was never the red mechanism — both reds are structural.

## What this PR delivers

The gap that remained actionable: **the grammar-side regression pin lived inside the quarantined file, and the quarantine skip is per-FILE** (`scripts/apply_quarantine.py` drops the whole path) — no PR gate has executed the canonicalizer pin since #1423 quarantined it.

- **New `test/integration/pty_resume_transcript_pin_test.dart`** (233 lines, no PTY, `@Tags(['integration'])` → auto-bin-packed into the integration shards): replays the **verbatim failed-job dump rows** of both signature-2 runs through the production `transcriptOf`:
  - the exact red board row (`✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok`) and the full ⠿/⏸/✓/✗ × run/wait/done/fail vocabulary stay chrome;
  - the settlement notice block (4 `│ ⚙` rows + wrap continuation) stays transcript grammar;
  - the red scenario's settled cards canonicalize identically across legs (live `0s` vs replay `—`, the #916 contract);
  - the red live screen normalizes to the post-#1420 tail, the red resumed tail is canonicalizer-idempotent, and the two tails **align 1:1 on the last-liveTail-length window — the exact assertion that red at those SHAs** (it fails under pre-`4b81205c` classification, passes at HEAD).

## Delivered vs remaining

- [x] Both red signatures root-caused to product bugs already fixed on main (#1410 / #1420), with FILE:LINE and commit evidence
- [x] Regression guard for the AC1 canonicalizer restored to **gate visibility** (new un-quarantined pin file, PTY-free)
- [x] Sig-1 guard verified already gate-visible (`test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart` — not quarantined)
- [x] No quarantine-list churn (contested file untouched), no PTY-flow changes, no product-code churn
- [ ] **Un-quarantine** `test/integration/pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart` (remove the entry at `scripts/test_quarantine.json:141-150`) — blocked on the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof showing **both** prior red paths green (nightly keeps running the file supervised). Bot/SM-owned; this PR is the fix-PR reference the entry's review needs.
- [ ] Optional follow-up after un-quarantine: screen-anchored wait (`waitForScreen`) on the last replayed notice row ahead of the settle snapshot — deferred because the quarantined file cannot be exercised per-PR, making any flow change unverifiable until nightly.

## Local execution evidence

`dart` on this host is sandbox-blocked: homebrew shim fails on the flutter engine stamp, and the direct VM binary is `Killed: 9` (exit 137) — `dart --version` itself cannot run, so no local test/analyze/format execution was possible (consistent with the openpty-denied evidence from sibling lanes; this host cannot run PTY suites at all). The fix is driven entirely from the red-run job logs (jobs API, FILE:LINE above) plus code reading; no local green is claimed or fabricated. The pin file is deliberately PTY-free so the gate CAN execute it.

"""Apply the gh-1199 AC6 flake quarantine to a set of test targets.

Reads candidate test paths (one per line) from stdin, or as positional

listed in scripts/test_quarantine.json are dropped — with a `::warning::`
per skip, so the gate log always shows what the quarantine is shielding
(E3: a quarantine must never swallow a real regression silently).

    python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json 0 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    find test/integration -name '*_test.dart' \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check

        existing files that are tagged `integration` and carry an issue

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag

LIST_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         "test_quarantine.json")

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("file", "issue", "since", "runs")


def load_quarantine(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    entries = doc.get("quarantined")
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: 'quarantined' must be a list")
    return entries


def quarantined_files(entries: list) -> set:
    return {e["file"] for e in entries}

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent

      - name: dart test --tags integration (linux, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/3)
        env:
          # gh-1300 FA_BIN seam: every CLI spawn (pty_harness + the
          # headless helpers via faCliCommand) runs the AOT binary —
          # ~1 s per spawn instead of the JIT VM+CFE compile (~30 s on
          # loaded ARM runners). Per-test isolation is unchanged.
          FA_BIN: ${{ github.workspace }}/fa-local/bundle/bin/fah
        run: |
          # gh-1199 AC1: --exclude-tag llm keeps every live-provider file

          # backstop. AC6: the quarantine filter drops flake-quarantined

          targets=$(python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json ${{ matrix.shard }} --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py)

+/// Gate-visible red-data regression pin for issue #1422 — the
+/// `AC1: resume renders 1:1 with live (normalized diff empty)` flake.
+///
+/// The flake red-died three times (runs 37798533323, 37774628085,
+/// 37802938457) at two sites inside `pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart`'s
+/// AC1 PTY test:
+///
+/// - Signature 1 (run 37774628085): the live leg's 30 s `Background shell
+///   job` banner wait timed out because every scripted bash call died
+///   with `Tool error (bash): Cannot modify an unmodifiable list` — the
+///   #1408 red-head sorting `layerVendor`'s CONST empty list inside
+///   `redactBashCommandSecretShapes`. Fixed on main in 98ba890b8 (the
+///   emptiness check precedes the sort, lib/src/approval/
+///   bash_shape_redaction.dart) and pinned gate-side by
+///   test/approval/bash_shape_redaction_test.dart ("null for a command
+///   without any secret shape" — a no-shape command IS the
+///   const-empty-list return, the exact crash path).
+///
+/// - Signature 2 (runs 37798533323, 37802938457): the resumed tail
+///   aligned one row early. The live screen still showed the gh-1415
+///   subagent status board row `✓ done pty446 … 0s – …` below the
+///   settlement notice block, while the resumed boot never replays board
+///   rows (terminal-first-sight: rehydrated children are history, not
+///   news) — and the pre-#1420 canonicalizer treated that row as
+///   transcript grammar, so the AC1 alignment window slid one row.
+///   Fixed on main in 336042cfd (#1420): the `_subagentBoardRow` rule
+///   classifies the board vocabulary as chrome. But the pin test
+///   carrying that rule lives inside the quarantined file, and the
+///   quarantine skip is PER-FILE (scripts/apply_quarantine.py drops the
+///   whole path from every PR gate) — so a canonicalizer regression
+///   would reach the AC1 PTY run before any gate caught it. This file
+///   re-pins the rule, and the red run's full row-level alignment,
+///   where every PR gate executes it. No PTY needed: everything below
+///   runs the production `transcriptOf` canonicalizer on the exact
+///   failed-job dump rows.
+///
+/// The fixtures are the failed-job dump rows verbatim (runs 37798533323
+/// and 37802938457, 2026-10-08), with the live-side settled cards rebuilt
+/// in the #916 band shapes the AC1 contract pins (`✔ name: detail 0s`
+/// live, `✔ name: detail —` replay). Un-quarantining the PTY file still
+/// requires the gh-1199 AC4 nightly repeat-run proof; this pin makes the
+/// grammar side of that proof continuously gate-checked in the meantime.
+@TestOn('vm')
+@Tags(['integration'])
+library;
+
+import 'package:test/test.dart';
+
+import 'pty_resume_equivalence_test.dart' as resume_eq;
+
+/// The anchor row every single-row probe hides below: a grammar-looking
+/// (`>`-prefixed) row the trailing-trim walk stops at, so the row under
+/// test always reaches the chrome/canonical pass regardless of whether it
+/// is itself a trim breaker.
+const _anchor = '>_Fa anchor row';
+
+/// Runs one screen row through the production canonicalizer. Returns the
+/// canonical transcript form, or null when the row is chrome (dropped
+/// from the AC1 comparison entirely).
+String? _classify(String row) {
+  final out = resume_eq.transcriptOf([row, _anchor]);
+  final kept = out.where((r) => r != _anchor).toList();
+  return kept.isEmpty ? null : kept.single;
+}
+
+/// The settlement notice block as the red run's two screens painted it
+/// (identical on both legs — these rows replay 1:1 by contract).
+const _noticeRows = [
+  '│ ⚙ Background shell job sh-2-hn0vwtxwhq6jh520 finished with exit code 0.',
+  '│ ⚙ Command: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  '│ ⚙ Log: /tmp/fa446pVLZPVV/.fah/bash_jobs/sh-2-hn0vwtxwhq6jh520.log',
+  '│ ⚙ Check the result with bash_job (action: output) or by reading the log file,',
+  'and act on it when the result was awaited.',
+];
+
+/// The resumed screen's transcript at the red snapshot (run 37802938457
+/// failed-job dump, `resumed transcript` block) — already in canonical
+/// form, which the canonicalizer must reproduce verbatim (idempotence on
+/// its own output).
+const _redResumeTail = [
+  'run the pinned probes for four forty six',
+  '>_Fa ## Plan',
+  '• run pinned probes',
+  '1. first step',
+  '2. second step',
+  'bash: echo pinned-render-1',
+  'bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  'task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok',
+  '>_Fa done — the probes settled',
+  ..._noticeRows,
+];
+
+/// The live screen's transcript at the red snapshot (the same dump's
+/// `live transcript` block, 9 rows) — pre-#1420 this carried the board
+/// row the resumed boot never paints, which is the whole flake.
+const _redLiveTail = [
+  'bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render',
+  'task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok',
+  '>_Fa done — the probes settled',
+  ..._noticeRows,
+  '✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single word ok',
+];
+
+void main() {
+  test(
+    'gh-1422 sig-2: the exact red board row is chrome, never transcript '
+    'grammar',
+    () {
+      expect(
+        _classify('✓ done pty446             0s    – reply with the single '
+            'word ok'),
+        isNull,
+        reason:
+            'the subagent board row re-entered the transcript grammar — '
+            'the AC1 alignment window shifts one row again (issue #1422 '
+            'signature 2: run 37802938457, location [0] off-by-one)',
+      );
+    },
+  );
+
+  test('gh-1422: the full subagent board vocabulary stays chrome', () {
+    // The gh-1415 vocabulary is one glyph per display state; the matcher
+    // accepts glyph+verb pairs as painted. Every combination must drop,
+    // or a vocabulary rename silently reintroduces the sig-2 off-by-one.
+    for (final glyph in ['⠿', '⏸', '✓', '✗']) {
+      for (final verb in ['run', 'wait', 'done', 'fail']) {
+        expect(
+          _classify('$glyph $verb probe-child      1.2s    – probe task'),
+          isNull,
+          reason: 'board row "$glyph $verb …" leaked into the transcript',
+        );
+      }
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('gh-1422: the settlement notice block stays transcript grammar', () {
+    for (final row in _noticeRows) {
+      expect(
+        _classify(row),
+        row,
+        reason: 'a settlement notice row went chrome — the resumed tail '
+            'loses rows the live tail keeps (issue #1422 failure class)',
+      );
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('gh-1422: settled cards canonicalize identically across the legs',
+      () {
+    // The #916 contract on the red scenario's exact cards: the live card
+    // carries the elapsed cell, the replay card the honest `—` — both
+    // must canonicalize to the same `name: detail` core or AC1's 1:1
+    // equality red-dies on the card rows themselves.
+    const cards = [
+      [
+        '✔ bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render 0s',
+        '✔ bash: sleep 2 && echo bg-pinned-render —',
+      ],
+      ['✔ bash: echo pinned-render-1 0.3s', '✔ bash: echo pinned-render-1 —'],
+      [
+        '✔ task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok 4.1s',
+        '✔ task: PTY equivalence probe; reply with the single word ok —',
+      ],
+    ];
+    for (final pair in cards) {
+      final live = _classify(pair[0]);
+      expect(live, isNotNull, reason: 'live card dropped: ${pair[0]}');
+      expect(
+        live,
+        _classify(pair[1]),
+        reason: 'live/replay card cores diverged for ${pair[0]}',
+      );
+    }
+  });
+
+  test('gh-1422: the red live screen normalizes to the post-#1420 tail', () {
+    // The live screen's tail at the red snapshot, rebuilt in the shapes
+    // the band contract paints: settled cards with live elapsed cells,

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply the gh-1199 AC6 flake quarantine to a set of test targets.

Reads candidate test paths (one per line) from stdin, or as positional
arguments, and prints the paths that STAY in the gate to stdout. Files
listed in scripts/test_quarantine.json are dropped — with a `::warning::`
per skip, so the gate log always shows what the quarantine is shielding
(E3: a quarantine must never swallow a real regression silently).

Usage (the CI legs pipe their shard selection through it):

    python3 scripts/shard_files.py scripts/test_integration_shards.json 0 \
        --tags integration --exclude browser_ext --exclude-tag llm \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    find test/integration -name '*_test.dart' \
      | python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py

    python3 scripts/apply_quarantine.py --check
        validates the quarantine list itself: entries must reference
        existing files that are tagged `integration` and carry an issue
        link — a stale or under-documented entry fails the static gate.

The list is checked in and reviewed in the fix PR; flake_watch.py
(auto-filed flake issues) proposes entries with the proving runs attached.

Pure stdlib. Exit 0 on success, 1 on a malformed list or --check failure.
"""

import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
from shard_files import file_has_tag

LIST_PATH = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)),
                         "test_quarantine.json")

REQUIRED_FIELDS = ("file", "issue", "since", "runs")


def load_quarantine(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        doc = json.load(f)
    entries = doc.get("quarantined")
    if not isinstance(entries, list):
        raise ValueError(f"{path}: 'quarantined' must be a list")
    return entries


def quarantined_files(entries: list) -> set:
    return {e["file"] for e in entries}


def check(path: str = LIST_PATH) -> int:

# AGENTS.md

Conventions for AI agents and contributors in this repository. Keep it
factual: paths, commands, invariants — no essays.

## Project layout

- `lib/` — the `flutter_agent_harness` package (pure Dart core). `test/`
  mirrors it. `prompts/` — all LLM prompts as Markdown (see rules below).
- `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart` (the barrel) — gh-1232 policy:
  GROUPED APPEND-ONLY export sections, one `// ── <subsystem> ──` comment
  header per group, exports sorted by path within a group, new exports
  appended to their subsystem group (a new subsystem starts a new group).
  No per-subsystem mini-barrels, no re-sorting of existing lines — append
  only, so parallel edits almost never touch the same line.
- God-file ceiling (gh-1232): no Dart file over 2800 lines anywhere
  (crap4dart `loc` gate, `max_lines: 2800` — issue #1234 migrated the
  shell guards; enforced whole-tree in CI and on staged files by the
  pre-commit hook. Scope: core `lib bin` via `crap4dart.yaml` +
  `test example` via the `crap4dart.loc-scope.yaml` companion config
  (0.11.0 has no per-gate sources override), flutter_app/lib via
  `flutter_app/crap4dart.yaml`).
  Target < 2000 for primary
  files; when a file approaches it, split by concern into `part` files
  (the established pattern: `agent_cli.dart`, `builtin_tools.dart`,
  `bin/fah.dart` → `bin/fah_*.dart`, `agent_service.dart` →
  `agent_service_*.dart` mixins) — never by extracting public API.
- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers (read/write/exec),
  session modes (always-ask/write/yolo/autopilot — the CLI label of the
  `unattended` enum), per-tool overrides,
  critical-pattern
  `bash` interceptor, per-turn grants (`grantForTurn(allow:, deny:)` —
  skill `allowed-tools`/`disallowed-tools` manifest keys ride these for one
  turn; explicit deny > turnDeny > per-tool override > turnAllow >
  alwaysAllow > mode (critical bash outranks mode in always-ask/write/yolo,
  but is skipped in unattended so the mode never blocks — for runs with no
  user present); `clearTurnGrants()`
  on every new user
  message). Wired via `attachApproval` into `beforeToolCall` (runs
  first); prompt UI is an injectable `ApprovalPrompt` (null + prompt policy
  = deny).
- `lib/src/tools/ask_tool.dart` — `ask` tool: structured mid-turn questions
  via injectable `AskCallback` (null = error, cancel = plain result).
- `lib/src/tools/request_secret_tool.dart` — `request_secret` tool: the agent
  asks the USER for a missing credential via injectable
  `RequestSecretCallback` (never in chat text); a grant returns
  `RequestSecretResult` (host-adjusted `name`, `value`, `persisted` flag),
  a decline is a plain result. The app wires it in `AgentService` to
  `secretRequestHandler` (chat screen installs
  `ui/widgets/secret_request_sheet.dart`): a grant is persisted into
  `SessionKeysStore`, injected into the live shell env via
  `SecretsExecutionEnv.addSecrets` (the map is runtime-mutable now), and
  registered into the same `SecretRedactor` — so the next run's prompt name
  list, bash `$NAME`, and redaction all pick it up.
- `lib/src/env/session_vars_execution_env.dart` — `SessionVarsExecutionEnv`:
  an `ExecutionEnv` decorator injecting session-correlation env vars
  (`FAH_SESSION_ID`/`FAH_SESSION_FILE`/`FAH_PROVIDER`/`FAH_MODEL`, resolved
  live per `exec`, never secrets) into bash tool executions. Wired around
  `builtinTools` in the CLI (`AgentCli`) and the app (`AgentService`).
  `LocalShell` merges `ShellExecOptions.env` OVER `Platform.environment`
